text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, hear ye! I am Yukino Bijin! 
A... a hauler for the grand parade float, 
don'tcha know!

text_block_list.name: Grand Float Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so cool! 
So that's an introductory proclamation!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! What say you, Lady Scarlet? 
Will you be giving a proclamation for your 
horseback archery as well?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I will. If we want people to call our 
names, 
they need to know what our names are 
first.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And while we're at it... I'm thinking of 
setting aside time 
for them to call our names right as we 
make our entrance.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Boo's group will do that for the 
steeplechase too! 
Some girls can focus better if having 
their names called 
is kept separate from the actual program.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! 
It's time to write down our "bonds" on 
these! 
Our very own—names!!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Led by the Divine Steeds, 
it appears the rituals of the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai 
have taken on a brand-new form.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-sama. 
Lady Daiwa Scarlet spoke of this.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
That if umamusume receive prayers 
channeled through their names, 
they may well bring forth unforeseen 
miracles.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: —Truth be told, I have long felt the same.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Since many, many years ago. 
Were not an umamusume's name meant to be 
called?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...All for the sake of the miracles born 
from it.
Just then, I felt a tap on my shoulder.

Clutched in <chrname>'s hands 
is a bond plaque.
choice_data_list: Wait—do you want me to write it?
Wait—is it alright if I write it?
Could it be—you wish for me to write it?

text_block_list.text:
<chrname> nods. 
I take her bond plaque into my hands.

—Only a little longer until the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai.
